name: The Foundry
description: Act 2, chapter `the-foundry` (STORY.md §16): the `foundry` mission on Cinder, where every probe was made. Black rock terraces in the north-west, dark basalt plains streaked with cooling lava, geothermal vents along the hot seams. On a big levelled terrace the print hall (`print-hall`: three empty cradles, one per probe); on a high bench west of it the Director's booth (`director-booth`: a chair, a light, a lens; `director-three`). North-east of the Core a long straight raised ramp climbs 20 u to the north-east (`launch-rail`). South-east, a low basin of hot slag (`slag-lake`). Accord-pattern sentinels guard it: relic grid `foundry` (five sentinels, two nodes, a cache in the hall) and `rail` (three sentinels and a node along the rail). No wildlife, no flora (molten), packs ×0, 15 min grace. Setting `foundry-found` here wakes the Clause sooner. Still needs: the hall's cradles and the booth as props or buildings, the rail as a structure, and the expedition package.
